highlights: The Green Lion GM-93X Microphone for Type-C Devices functions as a wireless microphone system that delivers high-quality sound recording capabilities.
The system uses 360° pickup technology to deliver audio that remains audible and understandable throughout all surrounding areas.

The system employs advanced noise reduction technology to produce sound that reaches 20dB noise reduction with a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of ≥ 65dB because it reduces background sounds for professional recording purposes.

The digital transmission protocol enables dependable connections that work at distances up to 40 meters and maintain audio delay times at or below 20 milliseconds, making it suitable for uninterrupted real-time communication.
The rechargeable case enables users to operate their devices for 14 hours, while the microphone provides 6 hours of continuous operation.
The system enables users to set up their equipment through its Plug & Play function, which requires no technical expertise.
This microphone system provides compact and portable design features, which make it ideal for recording activities during content creation, podcasting, and conference events.
The Green Lion GM-93X provides all the tools you need for superior audio performance.
